description: We would be delighted to welcome you to our 3 bedroom apartment.This apartment is ideally located in a quiet and central neighborhood, close to Gare de l'Est, the Canal Saint-Martin, and the many shops and restaurants of the 10th and 9th arrondissement.The spaceThe apartment is located on the 2nd floor with elevator access and includes:- A functional, fully equipped kitchen with a refrigerator, stovetop, oven, dishwasher, Nespresso coffee machine, kettle, toaster, and everything you need to cook as if you were at home- A beautiful and spacious living area filled with natural light, featuring a lounge and dining space. The lounge area includes a double sofa bed and a Smart TV. A ping-pong net can be set up on the dining table for entertainment- Three stunning double bedrooms with Queen-size beds (160x200), televisions, and storage to keep your belongings organized- Three private en-suite bathrooms connected to the bedrooms- Two separate toilets- A baby crib is available in the apartment- Smart storage: Thoughtfully designed storage solutions to keep your belongings neat and accessible- Connectivity: Enjoy high-speed WiFi and television to stay connected during your stayComplimentary toiletries (shampoo and shower gel) from Typology.- Linens and towels included: We provide high-quality bed linens and bath towelsGuest accessSubway: - Gare de l'Est (lines 4, 5, 7)- Château d'Eau (line 4)- Jacques Bonsergent (line 5)- Gare du Nord (lines 4, 5, RER B, D, E)Bus:Lines 26, 31, 32, 38, 39, 46, 54, 56, 91Other things to noteYour arrival is self check-in: the door is equipped with a secure system and a connected entry code.
